name: STIHL MS 291
blurb: 16″, 18″ and 20″ bars on .325″ chain, .063″ gauge, 67–81 drive links, per STIHL's chain-selection chart.
intro: The STIHL MS 291 appears in STIHL's saw-chain selection chart with 16″, 18″ and 20″ guide bars: the same .325″ pitch, .063″ gauge chain family as the MS 261 and MS 271. Each row below restates the chart's drive-link count, chain marketing number and recommended bar part number. The STIHL chart we could read is dated 1 October 2017, so for any saw made after that, confirm against the bar stamp or STIHL's current chart before ordering.

bars.note: STIHL's chart lists chain 26 RM3 67 with recommended bar 3003 812 7013.
STIHL's chart lists chain 26 RM3 74 with recommended bar 3003 812 7017.
STIHL's chart lists chain 26 RM3 81 with recommended bar 3003 812 7021.
